stem: Two unaffected parents are both carriers of the same autosomal recessive condition. What is the chance that each pregnancy will result in an affected child?
explanation: When both parents are carriers of the same autosomal recessive condition, each pregnancy has a 1 in 4, or 25 percent, chance of producing an affected child.
